cache_geometry.description: For each configuration name, compute the address decomposition parameters as defined in cache.sv.

per_config_fields.offsetlen: Number of byte offset bits within a cache line
per_config_fields.numsets: Number of sets in the cache
per_config_fields.settop: Top bit position of the set index field (first bit above the set+offset range)
per_config_fields.total_bytes: Total cache storage capacity in bytes across all ways

cache_simulation.description: Simulate each cache configuration against the memory access trace using the replacement policy implemented in the processor source.

per_config_fields.miss_rate: Miss rate as a fraction, rounded to 4 decimal places
per_config_fields.conflict_misses: Number of misses attributable to limited associativity rather than capacity (integer)

hazard_analysis.description: For each scenario, compute the hazard unit outputs for each cycle by implementing the combinational logic from hazard.sv.

per_scenario_fields.cycles: Array of output signal objects, one per input cycle
